author: Microsoft
description:
Episode 4 follows Tomorrow.io and its journey to leverage reinvent weather forecasting. Tomorrow.io builds advanced weather models on Microsoft Azure and NVIDIA, combining real time observations, AI, Machine Learning, and physics based approaches to predict extreme weather events faster and more accurately. Tomorrow.io leverages Azure and NVIDIA to close global data gaps, deploy satellite constellations, and turn planetary scale weather data into actionable intelligence to improve decision making.

Microsoft Azure and NVIDIA present Catalyst: a new series that spotlights the visionaries using AI to tackle global challenges.
